nodes.summary:
usage: corvint-corpus-parity [--mode parity] --index FILE --sha256 SHA256 --request FILE
       corvint-corpus-parity --mode query --index FILE --sha256 SHA256 --request FILE
       corvint-corpus-parity --mode build --root DIR --artifact FILE
Build refuses index, sha256 and request. Query/parity refuse root and artifact.
--artifact: producer /2 corpus
--index: embedded indexed artifact
--mode: build, query, or parity (experimental)
--request: query or question recording JSON
--root: source-revalidating producer only
--sha256: required operator-pinned index digest
Show command help or the offline machine catalog.
